lines.zh: 我在藤蔓之间滑翔过去。
lines.en: I glide between the vines.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀擦过叶子，沙沙响。
lines.en: My wings rasp the leaves.
I flip over beneath a leaf.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗的树冠里穿出来。
lines.en: I come out of the dark canopy.

lines.zh: 我在洞顶的钟乳石间穿行。
lines.en: I thread between the cave's stalactites.
I listen to the echoes as I fly.
I weave between the vines.
I skim over a fern.
I fly over shallow water.
I don't slow down in dense woods.
My shadow flickers among the leaves.
I climb a stretch.
I slip through a gap in the trees.
One beat of my wings and I turn.
I fly low to the ground.

lines.zh: 我落在树皮上停了一下。
lines.en: I land on the bark for a moment.
I hang upside down on a vine.
I hang from a vine, asleep upside down.

lines.zh: 一只飞蛾过去，我听见了。
lines.en: A moth passes; I hear it.

lines.zh: 水珠落地，我数清了距离。
lines.en: A drip falls; I know the distance.
It's dark here, and quiet.
I lick my claws.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地张开翅膀，又合上。
lines.en: I open my wings slowly, then fold them.
It's too bright outside.
An insect passes; I don't chase.
The cave's echoes are enough to navigate.
My teeth are small and sharp.

lines.zh: 我倒挂在藤上，翅膀发灰。
lines.en: I hang from a vine, wings grey with dust.
You came in. I heard.
I'm hanging above your head.
Your torch makes me squint.
I hang directly above you.
Don't wave that torch.

lines.zh: 你举着火，我就绕到背面。
lines.en: Raise that torch and I circle behind.
This cave is my usual flight path.
How long will you stay here?

lines.zh: 我忽然张开翅膀，你就退了。
lines.en: I spread my wings and you step back.
The smell of blood hangs in the air.
A tear opens in my wing membrane.
I drop some altitude.
I screech in pain.

lines.zh: 我扇着歪掉的翅膀退开。
lines.en: Wings askew, I flap backward.
That made my flight unsteady.
I hang on the wall, panting.
My ears are trembling.
You fight better than I thought.
I can still fly, but I want to hide.
I may have to give up this cave.
That light hurts my eyes.
That thing's wingbeats sound crisp.
I shift along the cave roof.
I don't like that heat.
I loop once beside your hand.
You've lowered the torch.
I wait for you to come further in.

lines.zh: 这个位置很好，正好俯冲。
lines.en: Good position for a dive.
My wings have opened a little.
I shouldn't care about that noise.
You look up and hit me.
One wingbeat and I retreat.

lines.zh: 我的翅尖扫过你的耳廓。
lines.en: My wingtip brushes your ear.
Don't swing your arms; I'm flying.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我掉了一点高度。
lines.en: We collide and I drop a little.
You step on fallen leaves.
I circle to the other side of the cave.

lines.zh: 这一碰让我偏离了路线。
lines.en: That knocked me off my line.

lines.zh: 丛林树冠下，我贴着叶背飞。
lines.en: Under the canopy I fly along leaf backs.

lines.zh: 我翅膀的边擦过你的脸。
lines.en: My wing's edge brushes your face.

lines.zh: 另一只从黑暗里飞出来。
lines.en: Another flies out of the dark.
We circle the same vine.
Its wings are broader than mine.
We hang side by side.
It touches its wing to mine.
We screech together.

lines.zh: 两根藤上挂着我们两个。
lines.en: We hang from two vines.

lines.zh: 我们飞出去，又一起回来。
lines.en: We fly out and come back together.

lines.zh: 洞顶的位置够我们两个。
lines.en: There's room on the roof for both.
At night we go out together.
I snatch an insect.
I catch it in my wing.
I hang it on the vine.
It's heavy; I can't lift it.
I stuff the prize into a vine gap.
I find it in the dark.
Mine. Don't snatch.
I carry it back up to the cave roof.
I carry it back to the cave.
I hang up there and eat slowly.
You've disturbed my cave.
From the jungle canopy, I dive.
I dart out from the vines.
Your torch bothers me.
You've backed to the cave wall.
You're the only one here.
I've locked onto your torchlight.

lines.zh: 我的回声告诉我你的位置。
lines.en: The echoes tell me where you are.
This one comes from behind.

lines.zh: 回声告诉我，你的背后是空的。
lines.en: The echoes tell me your back is open.
You'd better not look up.
I've longed for this moment a long while.
I follow you along the roof.

lines.zh: 你往左，我从上方绕过去。
lines.en: You go left; I circle above.
My wings are quiet.
I hide well in the canopy.
The jungle bat circles your torch.
I count the echoes of your steps.
I wait for you to reach a narrow spot.
I'm above your head already.
Looking back won't help.
One wingbeat and I'm there.
I fly low along the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边掠过。
lines.en: My shadow sweeps past your feet.
I burst out from behind the vines.

lines.zh: 我撕开一道口子就松口。
lines.en: I tear a gash open and let go.
It's light, but sudden.
You swing and I fly off.
After the bite I dart back to the roof.
My teeth sink into your shoulder.
The impact rocks you.

lines.zh: 丛林蝙蝠，贴着洞壁滑下来。
lines.en: A jungle bat slides down the cave wall.
I'm airborne again.
You heard me. That makes it harder.
Something stirs on the cave roof.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里掉出来，又飞起。
lines.en: I drop from the dark and catch myself.
Two more have come into the cave.

lines.zh: 翅膀声从树冠深处传来。
lines.en: Wings sound deep in the canopy.

lines.zh: 我挂在一根藤上，慢慢张开。
lines.en: I hang from a vine and slowly unfold.
A leaf rustles. That's me.
I fly out from under a fern.
It's dark here. Very suitable.
I circle the cave roof once.
I settle at the highest point.

lines.zh: 火苗一窜，我的翅膀就卷了。
lines.en: A flicker of flame and my wing curls.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，摔在地上。
lines.en: I fall from height and hit the ground.
Water in my fur; I can't fly.
The blast throws me against the cave wall.
An arrow pierces my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 法术让我的回声全乱了。
lines.en: That spell scrambles all my echoes.
There are few insects left in this cave.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我从藤上掉下。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and I drop from the vine.

lines.zh: 虚空把我从藤上拽下去。
lines.en: The void pulls me off the vine.
